interpretation: Higher pKd means stronger measured affinity.
Pair sequence ordering is lexical and does not imply wild type versus mutant.
Only same-target, same-assay, equal-length peptides differing at one position are compared.
Repeated records of the same target/assay/peptide are summarized using median pKd.
Mutation pairs can share peptide sequences and are not all independent.
Presence of a PDB ID does not prove the corresponding structure file is locally available or correctly chain-mapped.
This is a retrospective benchmark, not prospective experimental validation.
score_note: No recognized sequence-score column found in this affinity CSV. Mutation pairs were still enumerated, but score-vs-experiment directional concordance was not computed.
